### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. palmoplantar keratoderma i, striate, focal, or diffuse  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.731)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:3048)

**Proposed mechanism:** DSG1 (HGNC:3048) —DISRUPTS→ Epithelial cell adhesion and differentiation (GO:0050870); Epithelial cell adhesion and differentiation (GO:0050870) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal keratinocyte adhesion (HP:0007301); Epithelial cell adhesion and differentiation (GO:0050870) —LEADS_TO→ Palmoplantar keratoderma (HP:0000965). **How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in DSG1 that are exclusively associated with one of the two diseases, or evidence that other genes are the primary drivers of one of the diseases, would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: gnomAD analysis showing a common pathogenic variant in DSG1 (>1% allele frequency) associated with either disease.)_
